dct_description_sm: Body condition is an important factor in the health of individuals and populations. However,  most in-use condition indices (CIs) have not been properly validated and data collection to generate these CIs is logistically challenging. In this project funded by the United States Geological Survey (USGS), adipose samples from captured and remote biopsied polar bears collected from the southern Beaufort (SB) Sea subpopulation were utilized to assess the validity of adipose lipid content as a CI.
dct_title_s: Adipose lipid content of southern Beaufort Sea polar bears, 2004-2012
